scope: Working implementation above this base. File hashes identify the final reader content and delivered package. Desktop Chromium at 1440x1000; phone captures at 390x844. Each group was entered by a direct dataset URL, stepped through in order, checked at both disabled endpoints, and stepped back with Enter. Arrow runs remain applicable after changing only chooser detail strings to source names: control IDs, order, source/content/object.json and scientific assets are unchanged. The sourceLabels check and screenshots use the final source names. This is agent inspection, not reader testing or scientific validation.
